opabinia-regalis-representative-v1.review: Original-size pass: exactly five clustered head eyes and opposed bristled/spined proboscis tips readable.

opabinia-regalis-pattern-v1.prompt: Create a vertical high dorsal-oblique Opabinia comparison with exactly five tightly clustered head eyes and an opposed bristled/spined proboscis tip; preserve soft body, lateral lobes, gill blades and tail while changing camera and palette.
opabinia-regalis-pattern-v1.review: Original-size review hold: five-eye cluster and tip comb readable; perspective, transparency and color remain hypothetical.

opabinia-regalis-ecology-v1.prompt: Create a wide non-contact Burgess Shale shelf scene with one complete Opabinia; exactly five clustered head eyes and the opposed bristled/spined proboscis tip remain readable, with distant sponge-like organisms only.
opabinia-regalis-ecology-v1.review: Original-size anatomy-review acceptance; focal identity readable and ecology remains illustrative.
